def _hex4(s, pos):
    """Parse 4 hex digits at s[pos:pos+4]. Returns the integer value."""

        o = ord(c)
        if 48 <= o <= 57:
            d = o - 48
        elif 97 <= o <= 102:
            d = o - 87
        else:  # 65 <= o <= 70
            d = o - 55
        v = (v << 4) | d
